name: 02 - Briefing Approval and Delivery

parameters.notes: Send-and-wait node: post the draft (content_md) to the named analyst in Slack, wait for approval/edit reply. Configure Slack credential in n8n UI. On approval, call POST /brief/{{briefing_id}}/approve with approved_by set to the analyst's name.

nodes.name: Mark Delivered + Send to DG Office

parameters.notes: No approval reply within timeout window -> escalate to backup analyst. Configure timeout on the Slack send-and-wait node.

main.node: Mark Delivered + Send to DG Office
